_what: THE ARMS TAGGED BY WHAT THEY GUARD, (R327)(2): CLAIM where an arm guards a statement, a pin, a grade, a registration, a computed figure, or a sentence a reader of the corpus meets; CLOSE where it guards the close's own record of itself and nothing a reader of the corpus meets. Read by the suite's tallies and the closing (the claim arms' figure printed beside the whole suite's). Written at b717's step zero by the Write tool over the 139 arms of b716's suite as data/b716_arms_prerun.txt prints them (:65-:152, :184-:191, :219, :309, :335-:375), the act's arms carried under their b717 names (G-R326-ENTERED -> G-R327-ENTERED); an arm the act adds later is entered here by the Edit tool before the suite runs. At Component 6 (the Edit tool): b716's five toolset arms (G-TOOL-REPAIRS, G-REPAIR-CONTROLS, G-TOOLSET-SCAN, G-TOOLSET-REPLAY, G-COVERAGE-TABLE, all CLOSE) removed with their arms; six added (G-LIST-CERTIFIED, G-PREDICTIONS-BEFORE-ONSETS, G-ONSETS-HELD, G-COEFFS-LAW, G-NAMES-PINNED CLAIM -- the -39 figures and the names' pins a reader meets; G-ARM-TAGS CLOSE). An arm absent from this map is untagged and printed so by the tally, never counted as either. At b718`s Component 7 (tools via the scratchpad`s retag.py, its form proved by re-dump): b717`s eight arms over its own objects (G-LIST-CERTIFIED, G-PREDICTIONS-BEFORE-ONSETS, G-ONSETS-HELD, G-COEFFS-LAW, G-KEYSTONE-EDITS, G-NAMES-PINNED, G-PRICES-BANKED, G-NO-DISPATCH) removed with their arms; nine added -- G-DECOMP-REPRODUCED, G-DERIVATION-GRADED, G-A0-CERTIFIED, G-COUNT-READ, G-READS-BANKED, G-PIN-READ, G-RECORDS-PRICED, G-TOUCH-READ CLAIM (the derivation`s grade, A0, the reads, the pin, the ledger`s watch line and the entry`s touch a reader meets), G-TOOLSET-V120 CLOSE; G-REGISTRATIONS-FIRST kept, re-pointed to b718`s registrations; G-R327-ENTERED renamed G-R328-ENTERED (the carry`s act shift, not entered here at b718`s step zero).
